toolsPreview.name: get_home_prices
toolsPreview.description: Get US home price data. Returns national median home price (FRED MSPUS) or metro-level Zillow ZHVI data. Includes current value, YoY change, and 12-month history.

toolsPreview.name: get_rental_data
toolsPreview.description: Get US rental market data from FRED BLS CPI series. Returns national rent index, YoY change, and monthly history.

toolsPreview.name: get_market_indicators
toolsPreview.description: Get key US housing market indicators from FRED: housing starts, building permits, median home price, 30-year mortgage rate, and Case-Shiller index.
